output.reason_for_conversation: understanding A1C rise and disease progression
output.summary: User reported an A1C rise from 6.8 to 7.4 despite unchanged diet and activity, and worried it signalled rapid disease worsening. The bot explored common contributors and identified poor sleep with loud snoring (six months, multiple nightly wakings) and winter weight gain (5–6 pounds) as likely factors. User accepted that the rise was modest and workable, not an alarm. The bot recommended a two-week food and sleep diary, asking the doctor about individualized A1C targets and sleep evaluation, and clarified that fasting versus post-meal patterns guide treatment adjustments. User closed by restating the plan and expressing relief that the conversation was useful rather than fatalistic.
